premises.text: Fragmented travel sources and services make smooth planning impossible and leave travelers with irrelevant content and choice paralysis
premises.evidence_span: Millions of sources and services have made a smooth travel planning process impossible

premises.text: A single platform integrates travel sources and collects everything needed in one place
premises.evidence_span: Mapify integrates sources and information to collect everything in one place

premises.text: Travelers can access, create, and share visualizations of entire journeys as global hosts
premises.evidence_span: enabling every single traveler to be a global host for the places they visit and the activities they experience

premises.text: Interest-based personalization recommends relevant spots from community-shared experiences
premises.evidence_span: it automatically recommends spots for everything we've just selected

premises.text: An AI planner generates a trip timetable that orders spots by transport and matches recommended lodging
premises.evidence_span: Mapify pulls in hundreds of data points and generates a possible way of how your trip could look

premises.text: An AI content engine matches tags with photos, text, and attachments and sorts trips by relevance, quality, and personal importance
premises.evidence_span: an AI content engine we've built matching hundreds of thousands of tags with photos, text, and attachments

premises.text: Initial monetization focuses on the European millennial leisure travel subsegment
premises.evidence_span: We're focusing on monetizing the European subsegment first

premises.text: Revenue comes through brand and affiliate partnerships with leading travel brands
premises.evidence_span: generating revenue through brand and affiliate partnerships with some of the world's leading travel brands

value.text: A personal travel guide that creates a whole curated travel journey in seconds
value.evidence_span: Mapify is your personal travel guide that lets you create your whole travel journey in just a few seconds
